mails.subject: Founders Open Studio, Oct 22, free seats
mails.body:
Hi there,

Sending this from my phone between meetings so pls excuse the typos. Im reaching out to the Kanalhuset community because we think your members would get alot out of our Founders Open Studio on Oct 22 (online, 90 min). Its a live product launch of our new scheduling tool, with a demo and Q&A.

Seats are limited, register here: https://loopstage-live.example/open-studio

Hope to see some of your coworkers there!

Priya Nair
Community Lead, Loopstage
Sent from my iPhone
mails.justification: A mass product-launch webinar invitation sent to the space's shared inbox by a company the space never subscribed to or dealt with, despite the friendly community framing.

mails.subject: Opportunités pour vos membres
mails.body:
Bonjour,

TalentBrise recrute actuellement 40 profils développeurs et chefs de projet à Copenhague. Pourriez-vous relayer l'offre auprès des membres de Kanalhuset ? Liste des postes : https://talentbrise.example/postes

mails.subject: Opfølgning efter vores snak
mails.body:
Kære Kanalhuset,

Tak for en god snak til jeres arrangement i september. Det var inspirerende at se så mange iværksættere samlet under samme tag, og jeg tænkte med det samme, at vores to miljøer burde arbejde tættere sammen.

Nordlys Partners er et netværk for vækstvirksomheder i hele Norden, og vi åbner nu en række lokale "Partner Hubs". Som medlem af Partner Hub-programmet får Kanalhuset:

- eksponering over for vores 3.200 netværkskontakter
- et logo på vores partnerside
- invitationer til vores kvartalsvise investormøder

Deltagelsen koster 14.500 DKK om året, og første år kan betales i to rater. Jeg har vedhæftet en kort oversigt, og jeg kan sende en faktura med det samme, hvis I vil have fordelene allerede i november.

Tilbuddet gælder til og med 31. oktober, hvorefter prisen stiger til 18.900 DKK.

Glæder mig til at høre fra jer.

Med venlig hilsen
Anders Vestergaard
Partnerships Director, Nordlys Partners
https://nordlys-partners.example
mails.justification: The 'we spoke at your event' opening has no concrete detail and leads to a paid partnership pitch from a company the space has no relationship with.

mails.subject: Re: quick question about your desk bookings
mails.body:
Hi,

> Do you currently track enquiries from visitors in one place?

Just following up on my note below. We help coworking spaces turn website visitors into booked tours, setup takes 15 minutes. Worth a short call this week?

Marcus
mails.justification: The 'Re:' subject fakes an ongoing thread, but the quoted line is the sender's own cold pitch and the space never wrote to him.

mails.from: Office of Outreach, Halvorsen Digital Institute <outreach@halvorsen-digital.example>
mails.subject: Contributor invitation: Kanalhuset community blog
mails.body:
Dear Editorial Team,

The Halvorsen Digital Institute is pleased to extend a formal invitation to contribute to our Nordic Workplace Review, a publication read by managers and operators of shared workspaces.

Having reviewed the Kanalhuset website, we believe that your community would be well served by a reciprocal arrangement. We propose the following:

1. We publish a guest article authored by your team, with a link to your site.
2. In return, you publish one article written by our contributors on your blog or news page.
3. Each article will contain up to two contextual links to client websites designated by us.

Our clients operate in the fields of online finance and travel, and the links will be placed inside the body text so that they appear editorial. For organisations without capacity to write, we offer article placement on your site for a one-time administrative fee of 250 EUR per article.

The Institute has no commercial affiliation with your space and conducts this programme on behalf of its sponsors. Our domain authority has been independently rated at 68.

We would be grateful for your confirmation of interest by the end of the month.

Yours faithfully,
Dr. Ingrid Halvorsen
Head of Outreach
Halvorsen Digital Institute
mails.justification: A formal link-building and paid guest-post scheme from an institute the space has never dealt with, dressed as an editorial invitation.

mails.subject: Payment issue on your Kanalhuset account
mails.body:
Dear member,

We attempted to process the monthly payment for your Kanalhuset membership but the transaction was declined by your bank. As a result your access card is scheduled to be suspended on Monday at 08:00.

Please note that the invoice below remains unpaid:

Invoice no. 2026-10-8841
Amount due: 2,450 DKK
Due: 2026-10-05

To avoid suspension, confirm your payment details through the secure member portal:
https://kanalhuset-accounts.example/portal/verify

You will be asked to sign in with your member email and password and to re-enter your card number.

If you have already made this payment, please ignore this reminder. Late payments may incur a fee of 150 DKK.

Thank you for being part of our community.

Kanalhuset Accounts Team
This message was sent automatically, please do not reply.
mails.justification: A phishing message imitating the space's own billing, sent to the space itself from a lookalike domain, asking to enter card details on an external link.

mails.subject: saw your space, thought of you
mails.body: Hey! 👋 Lars here. A friend who works at Kanalhuset said you guys are always looking for ways to grow 😄 We run a small private crypto pool, members are seeing ~18% a month. Put in 5,000 DKK to start and I'll set you up today. Text me back and I'll send the wallet link 🚀
mails.justification: A casual crypto-investment scam claiming a vague friend at the space, with no real relationship and a promise of unrealistic returns.

mails.subject: Hjælp til jeres medlemmer? Jobs i Ørestad
mails.body:

Skriver fra telefonen så undskyld stavefejl. Vi har lige nu 25 ledige stillinger indenfor kundeservice og lager i Ørestad, og vi tænker at nogle af jeres medlemmer eller deres netværk kunne være interesseret. Løn fra 195 kr i timen.

Mvh

Kontorfolk Vikarbureau
Sendt fra min iPhone
mails.justification: A staffing-agency blast asking the space to promote mass job ads, from a sender with no prior contact.

mails.subject: Great meeting you at the autumn meetup
mails.body:
Hello,

It was great to meet some of your team at the autumn meetup. I run Brightmoor Collective, a network of independent consultants, and I believe there is a natural fit between our communities.

I would love to explore ways of working together, perhaps through a joint listing or a shared referral programme. Our associates typically pay a small onboarding fee, and we share it with partners who send us leads.

Let me know when you would be free for a short call. I can also send our partner deck.

Kind regards,
Tom Alderidge
Founder, Brightmoor Collective
mails.justification: No specific meetup, person or detail is named, and the 'collaboration' is a pay-to-join referral scheme from someone the space does not know.
